prompts.title: 子瑜女仆角色扮演镜面自拍

prompts.title: 深夜屋顶停机坪抓拍
prompts.description: 一个详细的 JSON 提示，用于 Nano Banana 2 生成一张超逼真的深夜抓拍照片，内容是一位奢侈品 Instagram 模特在私人屋顶停机坪上。该提示指定了刺眼的 iPhone 闪光灯照明、自然的皮肤纹理、明确的姿势（主导的凝视、微妙的坏笑）以及一套高级时装（黑色紧身胸衣、超短裤、透明丝袜），背景是璀璨的城市天际线。

prompts.content:
A luxury skincare product still life, centered composition. A small matte green glass jar labeled “{argument name="product name" default="NEEDLY Cicachid relief cream"}” with a clean white lid sits in the middle on a soft beige background. Surrounding the jar are multiple transparent glass spheres of varying sizes, filled with water, air bubbles, and small green botanical leaves suspended inside.
The spheres create magnified distortions of the leaves and reflections. Soft natural sunlight shines from the upper left, casting warm highlights and elongated soft shadows across the surface. The lighting is bright, airy, and slightly golden, creating a premium, organic skincare aesthetic.
The arrangement is artistic and minimal, with overlapping circular forms and subtle reflections. The color palette is neutral beige, soft greens, and warm highlights. The surface is clean and matte, enhancing the glossy transparency of the glass spheres.

prompts.title: 超逼真 BTS 海绵宝宝场景
prompts.description: 一个高度详细、照片级的 Nano Banana 2 提示词，旨在生成一张真实电影制作拍摄水下场景的幕后照片，场景中包含卡通人物海绵宝宝和派大星。该提示词强调电影级灯光、实景搭建以及照片级环境与 3D 动画角色之间的对比。
prompts.content: Photorealistic behind-the-scenes photograph of a real film production shooting underwater. Two professional cinematographers in full black scuba gear and diving equipment operate a large underwater cinema camera rig. The set is a hyperrealistic practical build of SpongeBob's Krusty Krab kitchen — pineapple-yellow walls, porthole windows with real water and fish outside, practical kelp-shaped lights hanging from above. SpongeBob himself is a perfect 3D animated character physically present on set — rubbery, cartoonish, big eyes — standing behind the Krusty Krab grill holding a spatula, mid-performance, completely in character. Patrick Star sits at a stool nearby. A boom mic operator in scuba gear holds a waterproof microphone boom. Bubbles float upward through golden underwater light. The lighting is warm, cinematic — a mix of practical set lights and shafts of filtered blue ocean light from above. Everything is photorealistic EXCEPT the cartoon characters themselves. Film grain, anamorphic. Shot on RED Dragon, 24mm.
prompts.translatedContent: 一张电影制作幕后照片，真实感十足，拍摄地点在水下。两名身穿全套黑色潜水服和潜水设备的专业摄影师正在操作一台大型水下电影摄影机。场景是《海绵宝宝》蟹堡王厨房的超逼真实景搭建——菠萝黄的墙壁，舷窗外有真实的水和鱼，上方悬挂着海带形状的灯具。海绵宝宝本人是一个完美的 3D 动画角色，真实地出现在片场——橡胶质感，卡通化，大眼睛——他站在蟹堡王烤架后面，手持锅铲，正在表演中，完全融入角色。派大星坐在附近的一张凳子上。一名身穿潜水服的吊杆话筒操作员手持防水话筒吊杆。气泡向上漂浮，穿过金色的水下光线。灯光温暖，富有电影感——混合了实景灯光和上方过滤下来的蓝色海洋光束。除了卡通角色本身，一切都具有照片级的真实感。画面带有电影颗粒，变形宽银幕效果。使用 RED Dragon 摄影机，24mm 镜头拍摄。
